extracted.name: Family breakfast station
extracted.description: Let the kids help to assemble this breakfast station sharing board before tucking in. It’s a great way to start a special day, such as Mother's Day
ingredient_lines: large handful of strawberries (we halved the strawberries)
1 avocado peeled, halved, stoned and sliced
instruction_lines: Fry the bacon in a dry frying pan over a medium-high heat for 2 mins on each side, or until crisp. Spoon the yogurt into a small bowl, drizzle with honey and place on a shallow dish with the strawberries alongside. Spoon the soft cheese into a second small bowl, season with black pepper and put on a shallow dish alongside the salmon and lemon wedges. Put the avocado slices and bacon on another plate. Arrange all the dishes on a large serving tray, leaving space in the middle.

Melt the butter in the frying pan over a low-medium heat. When foaming, pour in the eggs and stir with a spatula until set to your liking. Stir in the cream. Season. Tip into a bowl, scatter with the chives and put in the centre of the tray. Serve with the warm croissants and bagels.
